headline: CSN Enters Exclusive Talks to Sell CSN Cimentos to Huaxin for R$12.7B
summary: Companhia Siderúrgica Nacional signed a ten-day exclusivity agreement with China's Huaxin Building Materials Group to negotiate the sale of CSN Cimentos for an enterprise value of R$12.7 billion.
why: Large divestments by major industrial conglomerates alter balance sheets, debt levels, and asset allocations, drawing significant investor attention.

impacts.name: Companhia Siderúrgica Nacional
impacts.why: Asset sales at substantial enterprise valuations can improve the liquidity and valuation metrics of the selling company.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A multi-billion-dollar divestment announcement directly impacts the valuation and capital structure expectations of the involved corporate entities.
